lines: Devinjit Singh is an Investor Selling Shareholder with up to ₹0.91 crore in proceeds if all 6,750 offered shares sell; money in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Recent trigger: shares unlocked 66 days ago on 9 Sep 2026, though this is unlocked shares, not cash.
Their retained stake is an estimated ₹2.13 crore at offer price; up to ₹0.67 crore gain before offer expenses and taxes.
Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table, holdings found in one section only.
